highlights: You can now set how far up the correction reaches.
The result card says why each band was left alone.
The "corrects X–Y kHz" line was wrong whenever a ceiling applied.
The parametric export always names its correction band, and now names the right one.
A/B switch on Home, and it does not cheat.
"JBL Bar 2.0 · Open stage" is now "· Air".
